messages.text: What are the most important signaling test capabilities for applications in Semiconductor?

For chip-vendor and device-ecosystem testing, the covered test scope includes RF, signaling, application, OTA, pre-conformance, conformance approval, carrier acceptance, non-signaling RF, signaling protocol, and service/repair testing [19][21].
Key signaling test capabilities include LTE and 5G NR network emulation across LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, and TDD [5].
Key signaling test capabilities include NR FR1 / NR FR2 signaling and TX measurements [5].
Key signaling test capabilities include LTE signaling, LTE direct-to-cell communication, and LTE measurements [5].
Key signaling test capabilities include WLAN signaling and WLAN TX measurements for 802.11a/b/g/n/ac, 802.11ax, 802.11be, 802.11bn, and 2x2 MIMO [5].
Key signaling test capabilities include NB-IoT / NB-NTN signaling [5].
Key RF and PHY measurements include Power, Frequency, Spectrum, EVM, PER / BLER, and MIMO [61].
Key channel and performance capabilities include fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement, and PER measurement [5].
Key application-layer capabilities include application test, IP traffic analysis, IMS / audio, and POLQA [5].
Key IP application capabilities include DNS, IMS, Message Center, FTP, HTTP, DNS monitor, IP logging, iPerf, Ping, throughput, Max Throughput Wizard, and web server [6].
Key advanced IP capabilities include QoS, ePDG, N3IWF, delay measurement, IP tune tool, and SMPP / MT SMS advanced settings [6].
Key voice and audio capabilities include 4G / 5G IMS voice codecs AMR-NB, AMR-WB, EVS, POLQA perceived speech quality measurement, WAV player / recorder, file-based POLQA, and end-to-end audio delay [6].
Key automation capabilities include GUI, graphical scripting, Python-based XLAPI, and SCPI remote control [5].
Key pre-conformance automation capabilities include automated execution, validation, and comprehensive reporting with R&S CMsequencer for 3GPP 5G SA pre-conformance [42].
Key validation goals include chipset L1–L4 test plan verification, modem stack debug, IMS / SIP / TCP/IP end-to-end performance validation, app stack debug, 3GPP / carrier device test execution, and radiated / conducted testing [87].
Key Wi-Fi 7 signaling capabilities include real-world RF TX/RX testing, MLO, multiple RF chains, 2x2 MIMO, 6 GHz out-of-band discovery, coexistence, and E2E test capabilities [12].
Key NTN signaling capabilities include NR-NTN, NB-NTN, DTC, RF, protocol, signaling, E2E application, mobility, and application testing [55].
【推論】For Semiconductor chip and modem validation, the practical core set is multi-RAT cellular/WLAN signaling, RF/PHY measurements, channel impairment testing, IP/application testing, and automation, because the passages connect chip-vendor testing to RF/signaling/application workflows and list those CMX500 capability areas [5][19][21][87][89].

- [[4G 5G NR WLAN OTA MIMO stress testing]] 已整理 CMX500 OBT 與 Bluetest 的 4G / 5G NR / WLAN OTA MIMO stress testing；本來源較偏向 conducted / signaling configuration 與多技術 De-sense 驗證概念，未提到 OTA chamber。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

Wi-Fi 8 › 來源中的技術定位
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]]：

- [[IEEE 802.11bn]] amendment introduces advancements focused on consistent, high-quality connectivity across dense environments。
- 目標應用包含 growing number of connected devices、VR/AR、8K streaming、industrial IoT。
- [[Wi-Fi 8]] builds upon [[Wi-Fi 7]] foundation。
- 來源明示 final IEEE standard ratification 尚未完成；[[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的測試是在 ratification 前展示。

依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 在 MWC 2024 語境下仍是 yet-to-be-defined standard。

- [[R&S CMP180]] 將展示 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform loopback mode verification，並稱該 waveform 是 [[Wi-Fi 8]] potential waveform candidate。

Wi-Fi 8 › 與 R&S CMX500 / CMP180 的關係
[[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]] 稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 已加入 newly added [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] testing capabilities，並將在 [[MWC Barcelona 2026]] 驗證 [[Broadcom]] prototype [[Wi-Fi 8]] device。

[[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 則在較早 MWC 2024 語境中，把 [[R&S CMP180]] 的 480 MHz [[WLAN]] waveform loopback demonstration 描述為 potential [[Wi-Fi 8]] candidate，並將 [[R&S CMP180]] 定位為 future-proof R&D / production tester。

這兩種說法層次不同：[[R&S CMX500]] 來源是 Wi‑Fi 8 RF signaling tests / prototype device demonstration；[[R&S CMP180]] 來源是 480 MHz waveform loopback / candidate demonstration。

依 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]]，[[Wi-Fi 8]] 保留下列 [[Wi-Fi 7]] core physical layer parameters：

| 項目 | 來源說法 |
|---|---|
| supported frequencies | up to 7.125 GHz |
| channel bandwidth | up to 320 MHz |
| modulation | 4096QAM |
| multi-link | [[MLO]] |

以上是 PR 中對 Wi-Fi 8 的簡述，不等同於完整 IEEE 802.11bn normative specification。

2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card › 實體
- [[R&S CMX500]] — 來源主角；被定位為 integrated platform for FR1、FR2、FR3、Wi-Fi、fading、IP throughput、NTN、RF analysis 與 signaling。
- [[Anritsu]] — 競品公司；來源描述為 Japanese test & measurement vendor。
- [[Anritsu MT8000A]] — 來源描述為 Anritsu 5G NR FR1/FR2/FR3 測試平台，但需要多 RF boards、multiple boxes、external PC / tools。
- [[Anritsu MD8475B]] — 來源描述為 LTE / IMS / eCall solution。
- [[Anritsu MT8821C]] — 來源描述為 LTE / LTE-A / 3G / 2G RF solution，且 source 說 LTE RF still needs MT8821C。
- [[Anritsu MT8862A]] — 來源描述為 Wi-Fi tester；source 說 MT8000A 無 WLAN signaling，需獨立 MT8862A。
- [[Anritsu MT8852B]] — 來源描述為 Bluetooth tester。
- [[R&S CMW500]] — source 將它放在 R&S lifecycle 中，用於 2G/3G continuity / legacy RF。
- [[R&S CMP180]]、[[R&S CMP200]]、[[R&S CMW100 K06]] — source 將它們放在 R&S production test path。
- [[RFU18]] — source 稱 upcoming RFU18 提供 FR3 beyond 16 GHz / up to 18 GHz headroom；來源未提供正式規格文件。

2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card › 重點摘要
- 來源將 [[Anritsu]] 描述為長期經營的日本 test & measurement vendor，總部位於 **Kanagawa, Japan**，全球員工約 **4,000+**，在日本 T&M market share 被稱為 #1，但全球 footprint 較弱。
- 來源稱 [[Anritsu]] mobile test portfolio 是 fragmented、multi-hardware architecture，用於 [[4G]] / [[5G]] / [[6G]] testing。
- 來源列出的 Anritsu 產品組合包含 [[Anritsu MT8000A]]（5G NR FR1/FR2/FR3）、[[Anritsu MD8475B]]（LTE/IMS/eCall）、[[Anritsu MT8821C]]（LTE/LTE-A/3G/2G RF）、[[Anritsu MT8862A]]（Wi-Fi）與 [[Anritsu MT8852B]]（Bluetooth）。
- 來源稱 [[Anritsu MT8000A]] 需要 separate RF boards for FR1/FR2/FR3、external mmWave converters，並列出 boards 021/022/023/024/031/032/033；後文 weakness 另列 041，兩處 board list 不完全一致。
- 來源稱 Anritsu new FR3 option / module 覆蓋 **0.4–16 GHz**，並認為它相較 R&S upcoming [[RFU18]] / 18 GHz headroom 有 future-proofing 限制。
- R&S positioning statement：[[R&S CMX500]] 被定位為 single integrated platform，涵蓋 FR1 + FR2 + FR3、fading、IP throughput、NTN、Wi-Fi、RF analysis 與 signaling；Anritsu 被描述為需要 RF boards、external mmWave converters、multiple boxes 與 fragmented software tools。
- 來源列出的 R&S differentiators 包含 one-platform architecture、integrated fading + IP throughput、unified software ecosystem、FR2 / FR3 performance leadership、cellular + Wi-Fi single platform，以及 R&D → conformance → production path。
- 來源的 sales landmines 聚焦在 FR1 wideband beyond 400 MHz、FR1+FR2+FR3+WLAN+LTE one-box、integrated fading + IP load、unified software、multi-cell / CA / mobility without extra boxes，以及 FR3 frequency headroom beyond 16 GHz。
- 來源的 R&S offensive plays 包含 one-box FR1 + FR2 + FR3 + WLAN + fading + IP、FR2 / FR3 performance leadership、integrated WLAN signaling、R&D → conformance → production lifecycle、future-proof RedCap / NTN / ORAN / 6G、unified software ecosystem，以及 fewer boxes / lower TCO / higher throughput 的簡化訊息。

2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card › 概念
- [[Sales Battle Card]] — 本來源的文件類型；用於競品定位與銷售話術，不是 binding specifications。
- [[FR3 測試與 RFU18 battle card 主張]] — 本來源提出的 FR3 / 6G readiness sales claim，需與既有 CMX500 正式規格區分。
- [[Integrated Fading]]、[[IP throughput testing]]、[[Unified Software Ecosystem]]、[[WLAN signaling]]、[[FR2]]、[[mmWave]]、[[Carrier Aggregation]]、[[MIMO]]、[[NTN]]、[[RedCap]]、[[O-RAN]]、[[ORU conformance]]、[[ATE production scalability]]。

NTN test and measurement aspects › R&S CMX500 與 TS8980
來源將 [[R&S CMX500]] 描述為 5G NTN 測試平台：

- 可作 one-box testing setup。
- 可整合進 [[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]。
- 支援 NR-NTN、NB-NTN、DTC。
- 可執行 RF、protocol、signaling、E2E application、mobility、application testing。
- 支援 FR1、FR2 與 future FR3 regions 的 white paper level 描述；正式 frequency coverage 需回查產品 specs / heads / RF frontends。
- 支援 Constellation Insight tool，可 load、configure、visualize、deploy satellites。
- CMX500 hardware 同時可啟動 cells 數量有限；來源說目前一台 box 最多 six cells。

[[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]：

- 補充並擴展 CMX500。
- 支援 full type approval functionality。
- 支援 multiple cells、out-of-band emission、spurious emission、interfering / blocking performance tests。
- 作為 accredited / validated test platform 用於 conformance / certification。

NTN test and measurement aspects › NTN 對 T&M 的 paradigm change
來源指出 [[NTN]] 改變傳統 wireless T&M 假設：

- 傳統假設 UE mobile、network entities stationary。
- NTN 需考慮 UE 與 network entities 兩者 mobility。
- 測試條件需 reproducible、accurate、comparable，但 setup 需加入 high path loss、Doppler shift、time delay、delay variance、atmospheric effects、Faraday effect、scintillation、weather influences。
- satellite 入軌後 maintenance / replacement 困難，使 simulation、software-assisted testing、digital twin、in-orbit monitoring 更重要。

NTN test and measurement aspects › Signal generation、analysis 與 SpaceNexus
來源描述：

- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可配備 fading emulator，支援 TDL / CDL、custom fading profile、Doppler、delay、path loss，以及 [[R&S SMW-K820]] customized dynamic fading。
- [[R&S SpaceNexus]] 可設定 satellite constellation、UE position / mobility、time-variant Doppler、time-variant propagation delay、path loss、weather-induced attenuation，並 remote configure SMW200A。
- [[R&S FSW]] / [[R&S FSWX]] 支援 satellite payload testing、EVM、ACLR、group delay、DVB-S2X analysis、phase-coherent multichannel measurement。
- [[R&S PVT360A]] 被描述為 potential satellite production testing platform，整合 vector signal generator 與 vector spectrum analyzer。

CMX500 XLAPI Scenario Database › Status 定義
依 [[XLAPI-CMX_Scenario_Database]]：

- `defined`：test scripts having a defined test sequence。
- `implemented`：implemented but not yet fully verified test scripts。
- `verified`：verified test scripts。
- `planned`：tentatively foreseen as future test script package content；planned scripts 可能因更相關 test purposes 而從 package 移除。
- `verified sim`：以 UE software emulation 驗證的 test scripts，在詳細清單中列為 verified sim。

CMX500 XLAPI Scenario Database › 與 Sequencer Test Packages 的差異
[[CMX500 Sequencer Test Packages]] 依 [[Sequencer-CMX-Test_Packages_Database]] 整理 KC packages，例如 [[R&S CMX-KC550B]]、[[R&S CMX-KC660B]]、[[R&S CMX-KC661B]]、[[R&S CMX-KC665B]] 與 [[R&S CMX-KC350B]]。

本頁整理的是 KF xLAPI / scenario packages，例如 [[R&S CMX-KF600X]]、[[R&S CMX-KF606X]]、[[R&S CMX-KF651X]]、[[R&S CMX-KF655X]] 與 [[R&S CMX-KF690]]。兩者都可能有 verified / implemented / planned 狀態，但 package family、測試入口與用途不同，不可把 KC package verified counts 與 KF scenario counts 相加或互相替代。

CMX500 XLAPI Scenario Database › Minimum hardware patterns
[[XLAPI-CMX_Scenario_Database]] 中常見的 minimum hardware requirements：

- [[R&S CMX500 OBT]]：多數 NR、LTE-DTC、POLQA 與 Multi-SIM scripts 的基本平台。
- [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] (FR2 config)：FR2、NR-DC、FR2 fading、FR2 throughput、FR2 neighbor reporting 等 scripts。
- [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] + [[R&S CMW500]] Callbox：WCDMA / GSM Multi-SIM scripts。

本來源不提供 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 的完整 BOM、正式 bundle code 或 order number；硬體配置仍需回 [[R&S CMX500]]、[[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]、[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 與正式 configurator。

Signaling test solution › 重點摘要
- 本來源是 OneNote 複製出的 [[UAV]] signaling test solution 筆記，raw 轉檔日期為 2026-09-17；正文未標示正式發布日期、作者、文件版次或適用客戶 / 專案。
- 來源指出無人機常使用多種通信技術，例子包含 proprietary radio / image transmission、Wi‑Fi、[[LTE]]、未來 [[5G]]、[[RTK]]、[[SATCOM]] 與 encrypted frequency-hopping radio。
- 來源以多款無人機 / UAV 產品為例整理核心通訊技術：[[DJI Mini 4 Pro]]、[[DJI Mavic 3]]、[[DJI Mavic 3 Enterprise]]、[[Parrot ANAFI Ai]]、[[XAG P100]]、[[Skydio X2E]]、[[RQ-4 Global Hawk]] 與 [[Switchblade]]。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] RF frequency range 為 **400 MHz 至 8 GHz**，可提供 [[LTE]]、[[5G]] 與 [[Wi-Fi]] UE 的單一技術 signaling test。
- 來源列出 signaling test 可包含基本 RF 量測、application layer tests 與 protocol test；基本 RF 量測項目包含 Power、Frequency、Spectrum、[[EVM]]、[[PER]] / [[BLER]]、[[MIMO]]。
- 來源列出一組 [[R&S CMX500]] 5G test configuration，包含 [[R&S CMX-PB70H]]、[[R&S CMX-B200A]]、[[R&S CMX-B300C]]、[[R&S CMX-B600B]]、[[R&S CMX-KA100]] 與 [[R&S CMX-KM600]]。
- 來源列出一組 [[R&S CMX500]] Wi‑Fi test configuration，包含 WLAN signaling、WLAN TX measurement 與 WLAN ARB generator options，例如 [[R&S CMX-KS350B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS351B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS352B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS355B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS356B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS360B]]、[[R&S CMX-KM350]]、[[R&S CMX-KM351]]、[[R&S CMX-KM352]]、[[R&S CMX-KM360]]、[[R&S CMX-KW350]]、[[R&S CMX-KW351]]、[[R&S CMX-KW352]]。
- 來源指出如果 UAV 使用兩種以上通訊技術，通訊技術之間可能造成相互干擾；基於 [[R&S CMX500]] 支援多種通訊技術，可進行 De-sense validation。
- 來源對多技術整合驗證的配置原則是：software options 合併上述 5G 與 Wi‑Fi 表格，hardware 以滿足兩者中最大的 carrier aggregation 或 [[MIMO]] 作為配置。
- 來源末尾列出兩個待讀材料：本機 PDF `5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100.pdf`，以及 SharePoint 上 `Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient.pptx`；正文未擷取。

R&S CMX500 › mmWave extension 與 remote radio heads
[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 指出 3GPP FR2 frequency range 測試可由 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMXHEAD30]]、[[R&S CMXHEAD50]] 或 [[R&S CMXHEAD50-Evo]] 執行。Remote radio head 是獨立 compact unit，在 IF 與 5G NR FR2 frequency ranges 間執行 upconversion / downconversion。CMX500 與 remote radio head 的 split concept 可在 5G NR FR2 frequency range 使用短 RF cable lengths，以最佳化 radiated chamber test environments 的 link budget。

適用 radiated chamber test environments：[[R&S CMQ500]] shielding cube 與 [[R&S ATS800R]] CATR rack based antenna test system。

# TRI case: Test Result and capabilities

answer.text:
For chip-vendor and device-ecosystem testing, the covered test scope includes RF, signaling, application, OTA, pre-conformance, conformance approval, carrier acceptance, non-signaling RF, signaling protocol, and service/repair testing [19][21].
Key signaling test capabilities include LTE and 5G NR network emulation across LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, and TDD [5].
Key signaling test capabilities include NR FR1 / NR FR2 signaling and TX measurements [5].
Key signaling test capabilities include LTE signaling, LTE direct-to-cell communication, and LTE measurements [5].
Key signaling test capabilities include WLAN signaling and WLAN TX measurements for 802.11a/b/g/n/ac, 802.11ax, 802.11be, 802.11bn, and 2x2 MIMO [5].
Key signaling test capabilities include NB-IoT / NB-NTN signaling [5].
Key RF and PHY measurements include Power, Frequency, Spectrum, EVM, PER / BLER, and MIMO [61].
Key channel and performance capabilities include fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement, and PER measurement [5].
Key application-layer capabilities include application test, IP traffic analysis, IMS / audio, and POLQA [5].
Key IP application capabilities include DNS, IMS, Message Center, FTP, HTTP, DNS monitor, IP logging, iPerf, Ping, throughput, Max Throughput Wizard, and web server [6].
Key advanced IP capabilities include QoS, ePDG, N3IWF, delay measurement, IP tune tool, and SMPP / MT SMS advanced settings [6].
Key voice and audio capabilities include 4G / 5G IMS voice codecs AMR-NB, AMR-WB, EVS, POLQA perceived speech quality measurement, WAV player / recorder, file-based POLQA, and end-to-end audio delay [6].
Key automation capabilities include GUI, graphical scripting, Python-based XLAPI, and SCPI remote control [5].
Key pre-conformance automation capabilities include automated execution, validation, and comprehensive reporting with R&S CMsequencer for 3GPP 5G SA pre-conformance [42].
Key validation goals include chipset L1–L4 test plan verification, modem stack debug, IMS / SIP / TCP/IP end-to-end performance validation, app stack debug, 3GPP / carrier device test execution, and radiated / conducted testing [87].
Key Wi-Fi 7 signaling capabilities include real-world RF TX/RX testing, MLO, multiple RF chains, 2x2 MIMO, 6 GHz out-of-band discovery, coexistence, and E2E test capabilities [12].
Key NTN signaling capabilities include NR-NTN, NB-NTN, DTC, RF, protocol, signaling, E2E application, mobility, and application testing [55].
【推論】For Semiconductor chip and modem validation, the practical core set is multi-RAT cellular/WLAN signaling, RF/PHY measurements, channel impairment testing, IP/application testing, and automation, because the passages connect chip-vendor testing to RF/signaling/application workflows and list those CMX500 capability areas [5][19][21][87][89].

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

R&S CMX500 › Application tests 與 audio
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]：

- 未啟用 R&S CMX-KA100 等 application test license 時，IP application test functionality 降到最低；只能使用 standalone mode，不能連接 external servers，也不支援 IP based measurements 或 tools。
- R&S CMX-KA100 提供 internal IP services 與 IP connection to DUT 測試 applications，包含 DNS、IMS、Message Center、FTP、HTTP、DNS monitor、IP logging、iPerf、Ping、throughput、Max Throughput Wizard、web server。
- R&S CMX-KA110 增強 KA100，加入 QoS、ePDG、N3IWF、delay measurement、IP tune tool、SMPP / MT SMS advanced settings。
- R&S CMX-KA150 提供 IP analysis tool，用於監控與分析 DUT uplink / downlink IP traffic。
- R&S CMX-KA180 提供 audio codecs for 4G and 5G IMS voice call，支援 AMR-NB、AMR-WB、EVS，並包含 [[R&S CMX-ZG180A]] external sound card drivers and configuration settings。
- R&S CMX-KA181 加入 [[POLQA]]，用於 measuring perceived speech quality；measurement version 為 3，mode 為 full-band 或 narrowband。
- R&S CMX-KA401 支援 WAV player / recorder、upload/download WAV files、file-based POLQA measurements 與 end-to-end audio delay。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › R&D：R&S CMX500 single-box signaling testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- [[R&S CMX500]] 是 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester。
- 來源稱其已新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- 目的在 single instrument setup 中測試 wireless device 在 cellular 與 non-cellular latest-generation standards 下的 operation。
- Wi-Fi 7 R&D 測試需在 signaling mode 與 real-world conditions 下量測 RF TX / RX characteristics。
- [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，因此提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很重要。
- 來源列出的 Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests 包含 2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。

5G device testing value chain › 測試類型
來源列出的測試類型包含：

- [[RF]]。
- [[Signaling]]。
- [[Application testing]]。
- [[OTA testing]]。
- [[Pre-conformance testing]]。
- [[Conformance approval]]。
- [[Carrier acceptance]]。
- [[Non-signaling RF]]。
- [[Signaling Protocol]]。
- [[Service and repair]]。

5G device testing value chain
[[5G device testing value chain]] 是 [[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]] 中整理的 5G device ecosystem 測試分工：從 chip vendor、device manufacturer、test house 到 network operator，依 Lab、R&D、Production、Operations 與 Use cases 串接 RF、signaling、application、OTA、pre-conformance、conformance、carrier acceptance 與 service / repair 測試。

5G NR FR1 SA pre-conformance testing › Test case 自動化設定
依 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]]：

- Users 可配置 signaling 與 cell-related settings，以符合特定 test objectives。
- Test case 會依 selected test case 與 test ID，自動調整 relevant settings，包括 reference measurement channel（RMC）configurations、UL power control settings 與 additional spectrum emission values。
- [[R&S CMsequencer]] 3GPP 5G SA pre-conformance solution 包含於 [[R&S CMX-KC661B]] license，提供 automated execution、validation 與 comprehensive reporting。
- 使用 [[R&S CMsequencer]] 測試時，來源指向 application note 1C110，但 1C110 內容尚未 ingest。

依 [[CMX500_Callbox]]：

- Manual pre-conformance 可 quick switch to automated pre-conformance。
- 使用 same technology specific license。
- 來源以 `Sequencer-CMX-Test_Packages_Database.xlsx` 作為 sequencer / automated package 線索。
- [[CMSequencer]] 支援 select TCs、customize TCs、band combinations、R&D features、re-test failed items、pause on error 與 user-defined breakpoints。

NTN test and measurement aspects › R&S CMX500 與 TS8980
來源將 [[R&S CMX500]] 描述為 5G NTN 測試平台：

- 可作 one-box testing setup。
- 可整合進 [[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]。
- 支援 NR-NTN、NB-NTN、DTC。
- 可執行 RF、protocol、signaling、E2E application、mobility、application testing。
- 支援 FR1、FR2 與 future FR3 regions 的 white paper level 描述；正式 frequency coverage 需回查產品 specs / heads / RF frontends。
- 支援 Constellation Insight tool，可 load、configure、visualize、deploy satellites。
- CMX500 hardware 同時可啟動 cells 數量有限；來源說目前一台 box 最多 six cells。

[[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]：

- 補充並擴展 CMX500。
- 支援 full type approval functionality。
- 支援 multiple cells、out-of-band emission、spurious emission、interfering / blocking performance tests。
- 作為 accredited / validated test platform 用於 conformance / certification。

Signaling test solution › 重點摘要
- 本來源是 OneNote 複製出的 [[UAV]] signaling test solution 筆記，raw 轉檔日期為 2026-09-17；正文未標示正式發布日期、作者、文件版次或適用客戶 / 專案。
- 來源指出無人機常使用多種通信技術，例子包含 proprietary radio / image transmission、Wi‑Fi、[[LTE]]、未來 [[5G]]、[[RTK]]、[[SATCOM]] 與 encrypted frequency-hopping radio。
- 來源以多款無人機 / UAV 產品為例整理核心通訊技術：[[DJI Mini 4 Pro]]、[[DJI Mavic 3]]、[[DJI Mavic 3 Enterprise]]、[[Parrot ANAFI Ai]]、[[XAG P100]]、[[Skydio X2E]]、[[RQ-4 Global Hawk]] 與 [[Switchblade]]。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] RF frequency range 為 **400 MHz 至 8 GHz**，可提供 [[LTE]]、[[5G]] 與 [[Wi-Fi]] UE 的單一技術 signaling test。
- 來源列出 signaling test 可包含基本 RF 量測、application layer tests 與 protocol test；基本 RF 量測項目包含 Power、Frequency、Spectrum、[[EVM]]、[[PER]] / [[BLER]]、[[MIMO]]。
- 來源列出一組 [[R&S CMX500]] 5G test configuration，包含 [[R&S CMX-PB70H]]、[[R&S CMX-B200A]]、[[R&S CMX-B300C]]、[[R&S CMX-B600B]]、[[R&S CMX-KA100]] 與 [[R&S CMX-KM600]]。
- 來源列出一組 [[R&S CMX500]] Wi‑Fi test configuration，包含 WLAN signaling、WLAN TX measurement 與 WLAN ARB generator options，例如 [[R&S CMX-KS350B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS351B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS352B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS355B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS356B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS360B]]、[[R&S CMX-KM350]]、[[R&S CMX-KM351]]、[[R&S CMX-KM352]]、[[R&S CMX-KM360]]、[[R&S CMX-KW350]]、[[R&S CMX-KW351]]、[[R&S CMX-KW352]]。
- 來源指出如果 UAV 使用兩種以上通訊技術，通訊技術之間可能造成相互干擾；基於 [[R&S CMX500]] 支援多種通訊技術，可進行 De-sense validation。
- 來源對多技術整合驗證的配置原則是：software options 合併上述 5G 與 Wi‑Fi 表格，hardware 以滿足兩者中最大的 carrier aggregation 或 [[MIMO]] 作為配置。
- 來源末尾列出兩個待讀材料：本機 PDF `5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100.pdf`，以及 SharePoint 上 `Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient.pptx`；正文未擷取。

5G device testing value chain › Validation and Conformance 目標
來源指出 validation and conformance 測試目標包含：

- Chipset L1–L4 test plan and verification。
- Investigate and debug modem stack。
- Validate and optimize end to end performance of IMS / SIP / TCP/IP。
- Investigate and debug app stack。
- Plan、develop、execute 3GPP / carrier device tests。
- Radiated and conducted testing。

測試目的包含：

- Final product according to [[3GPP]] specs and KPIs 的 conformance。
- Final product for different carriers 的 conformance。
- New product introduction test framework 與 pilot production tests。
- 確認 HW / SW 如設計般運作。
- Cellular transceiver systems optimization。
- Meet 3GPP specifications or custom design criteria。
- Assure robustness / reliability and performance on L1–L3。
- Optimize each stack for highest throughput and defined KPIs。
- Ensure robustness / reliability and performance on IMS、TCP/IP stack and app protocols。

5G device testing value chain › 工具與平台 mapping
來源列出下列工具 / 平台 mapping：

| 測試層 | 來源列出的工具 |
|---|---|
| RF / parametric / characterization | [[R&S SMW200A]]、[[R&S FSW]]、Oscilloscopes |
| Signaling / protocol / application | [[R&S CMX500]]、[[R&S CMW500]]、[[R&S CMsquares]] |
| OTA / chamber | [[R&S ATS1800C]]、[[R&S CMQ]]、[[R&S ATS CATR]] |
| Production / manufacturing | [[R&S CMP180]]、[[R&S CMP200]]、[[R&S CMW100]]、[[R&S CMX500]] / [[R&S CMW500]] |
| Conformance automation | [[R&S CONTEST]] for RRM、PQA、LBS、PCT、NPT、RF OTA |
| Toolchain / scripts | [[R&S CMsequencer]]、[[XLAPI]]、[[SCPI]]、Python |
